notes.title: Version 1.0.0. is out!
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.0 update:
[list]
[*] Improved and polished Non-VR version
[*] Added zoom progress bar
[*] Better visuals of various items
[*] Updated UI
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Non-VR Version Available!
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.60 update:
[list]
[*]Non-VR Version Available.
[*]When no VR system detected, the app will run in Non-VR mode.
[*]Note: Non-VR is not the main focus of this app, so it is not polished for Non-VR systems.
[/list]
[h2]Keyboard And Mouse Controls[/h2]

[b]Z[/b] - Zoom In
[b]X[/b] - Zoom Out
[b]Left Shift[/b] - Fast Zoom

[b]Space[/b] - Highlight Objects

[b]Mouse Wheel[/b] - Zoom
[b]Left Mouse Button Drag[/b] - Rotate
[b]Left Mouse Button Click[/b] - Select Object

notes.title: "Multiverse" Update, Now Available!
notes.notes:
Update 0.8.5 Features:

* Added multiverse theory
* Improved visuals of the ISS and the astronaut
* Better VR interaction with objects - they can be thrown away
* XBox controller supported
* Changed Oculus button bindings
* Tuned visuals of various parts
